events.caption: Identical launches: forward speed 2.5, upward speed 4.5.
Identical launches: forward speed 2.5, upward speed 4.5.

setup: Matched airborne launches. Red enters yellow; blue remains outside. The film ends before either ball lands.
name: Acceleration zone

oracle.name: Acceleration zone
oracle.law: For red and blue, each step inside the yellow tile's footprint (|x|<2, |y|<2), at any height, sets v_x=0.35 when s=|v|<0.35, or scales v by 1.0015 when 0.35≤ s<6.
oracle.plain: Either ball gains extra motion inside yellow, even in the air.
oracle.plain_zh: 红球、蓝球进入黄色区都会获得助推，在空中也有效。
oracle.condition: Red or blue lies inside the yellow footprint, at any height.
oracle.effect: The world injects motion: an eastward seed at low speed, amplification below speed 6.
oracle.scope: Updates occur each physics step. Ordinary forces remain active, so net speed need not increase every instant.

reference: Identical initial preparation and impulses, with the altered program disabled.
